description: This file defines the Catalyst controller for managing purchase lists within the Coocook project. It includes methods for listing, creating, editing, updating, and deleting purchase lists, as well as handling related actions like removing ingredients from purchase lists. The controller interacts with project-specific models and URLs, and manages access control and routing.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::PurchaseList
classes.description: Catalyst controller class for managing purchase lists in the Coocook application.

methods.name: submenu
methods.description: Sets up submenu items for navigation related to purchase lists, unassigned items, and shop sections.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays a list of purchase lists with associated URLs, default date calculation, and access control.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Captures a specific purchase list by ID for further actions, or shows a not found error.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Prepares data for editing a purchase list, including shop sections and units, and computes next higher/lower values for items.

methods.name: remove_ingredient
methods.description: Removes an ingredient from a purchase list, then redirects to the purchase list edit page.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new purchase list with a specified date.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the name of an existing purchase list, with validation to prevent duplicates and empty names.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Redirects to the index action of the purchase list controller.
